summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Turkish football match analysis app with configured API key and live data. All backend APIs returning real match data and frontend displaying 9 matches correctly with proper navigation.

design_issues.issue: Match cards not stacking in single column on mobile (358px width instead of 1fr)

passed_tests: Backend health endpoint returns api_token_configured: true
Backend matches endpoint returns 200 with 9 real matches from football-data.org
Backend match detail endpoint returns Portsmouth vs Ipswich Town data correctly
Frontend home page displays 9 match cards with team logos and league names
Match cards are clickable and navigate to /match/{id} detail pages
Portsmouth vs Ipswich Town match detail page shows correct team names and Championship league
Match detail page displays Turkish text: 'Maçlara Dön', 'Maç Bilgileri', 'BAŞLAMADI'
Back navigation from detail page to home works correctly
Header logo 'Maç Analiz' links to home page
Turkish text renders correctly with diacritical marks (ş, ç, ğ, ü, ö, ı, İ)
Status badges show Turkish text 'BAŞLAMADI' for scheduled matches
Mobile responsive design - no horizontal scroll on mobile viewports
All required data-testid attributes present and functional
Team logos and league emblems display correctly
Match times and dates formatted properly in Turkish locale
